tool_args.rationale: All five observations are positive and end by H = 0.48, roughly 50 times shorter than the target horizon. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the gain reverses and constrains its late magnitude before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential adaptation law directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-window gains support this mechanism, but they do not separately constrain the slow amplitude and time constant well enough to forecast at H = 24.2.
It costs slightly less, but finer early-time measurements would not directly test the predicted late reversal.
The pilot does not demonstrate periodicity, and because input and horizon vary together, it cannot establish a horizon-independent input response.
